newsitem.title: UK: All five Brents kept ahead of deadline - trade.
newsitem.headline: All five Brents kept ahead of deadline - trade.

text.p: All five Brent cargoes turning wet on Friday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
Suko and Elf each kept an August 2-4 loader and BP kept an August 3-5 loader. J Aron and BP each kept cargoes loading August 4-6.

Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date. A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7646
